title: Host Network Visibility (netprobe) Configuration
description: Operator-facing netprobe config. Toggle Enabled to turn on eBPF process attribution — no other fields are required. The capture / DPI / device-binding fields are optional advanced settings, only needed for passive packet fingerprinting. Mirrors proto agent.netprobe.v1.VisibilityAgentConfig.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. When on, netprobe runs eBPF process attribution (the flow-to-process source behind attributed flows) on every interface with no further configuration; packet capture/DPI additionally engage only if capture interfaces or device bindings are set under Advanced settings.

capture_interfaces.title: Capture interfaces
capture_interfaces.description: Optional. Allowlist of NIC names to passively capture/fingerprint on. Empty means no packet capture — attribution still runs.

default_sample_interval_ms.title: Default sample interval (ms)
default_sample_interval_ms.description: Optional. Default per-device fingerprint sampling interval; overridable per device binding.

flow_table_max_entries.title: Flow table max entries
flow_table_max_entries.description: Optional. Upper bound on the in-memory flow table. 0 means auto (interface count x 65536).

process_snapshot_interval_s.title: Process snapshot interval (s)
process_snapshot_interval_s.description: Optional. Periodic process-attribution snapshot reconciliation interval. 0 means event-driven snapshots only.

external_flow_match_window_ms.title: External flow match window (ms)
external_flow_match_window_ms.description: Optional. Temporal window for matching external (non-process) flows by 5-tuple.

flow_attribution_ipc_batch.title: Batch attribution IPC
flow_attribution_ipc_batch.description: Batch process attribution events over the local netprobe-agent IPC stream. Disable only for debugging older agents or framing issues.

emit_raw_flow_attribution_events.title: Emit raw attribution events
emit_raw_flow_attribution_events.description: Emit every raw process attribution observation upstream for central correlation and forensic history. Disable to reduce agent CPU, IPC traffic, and CNPG writes on high-volume hosts; this degrades central attributed-flow joins until matched-only export is enabled.
